summary: Every task row can independently change exactly one requested count, giving an Omega(r) inspection lower bound matched by the single aggregate scan.

optimality.argument: If any task row is not inspected, changing only its submit_date between a working day and a weekend day changes both requested counts while leaving all observed rows unchanged. A correct algorithm must therefore classify all r rows, and the conditional aggregate does so once per row.

replacement_checks.evidence: An uninspected row's date can be changed from Monday to Sunday, decreasing working_cnt and increasing weekend_cnt.
The query performs constant weekday extraction and two constant-time counter updates for each task row.
Authored cases cover all seven weekday values, all-weekend and all-working inputs, repeated assignees, year boundaries, and leap day.
